chunks: He continued the narration until they said: Then we all said: 'O our Master, by Allah, Uthman is certainly the best of your Shia, and you have increased our knowledge regarding his position in your service, and that he is your representative and trusted one over God's wealth.' He said: 'Yes, and bear witness that Uthman ibn Saeed al-Amiri is my representative, and that his son Muhammad is the representative of my son, your Mahdi.'
ai.seo_question: Who is appointed as the representative of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari and his son Mahdi?
ai.summary: This narration from Kitab al-Ghayba highlights the institutionalization of the deputyship (niyaba) during the Minor Occultation, where Uthman ibn Saeed al-Amiri is affirmed not merely as a trustee but as the Imam's direct agent over divine wealth. The explicit designation of his son, Muhammad, as the representative of the Imam's son (the Mahdi), establishes a hereditary lineage of authority that underscores the continuity of leadership and the legitimacy of the Four Deputies in Shia jurisprudence.
